label: Exploratory V5 range/damage/Seam Pin candidate B
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, or reward authority.
It keeps candidate A's level-ground ideal-direct-hit range/damage projection so the only comparison variable is the explicitly configured Needlepoint Seam Pin tactical-core hypothesis.

Every legal Needlepoint cast is an ideal direct hit: it deals low direct damage and applies one target-turn tether that caps only the target's distance-increasing movement at 32 units; the target may still cast, hold, or move toward the caster.
The caster cannot apply another Seam Pin on their immediately following turn; terrain, aim, splash, animation, and a production counter-effect are intentionally excluded.
